description: List reusable prompt templates available in the selected workspace. Returns templates to inspect and select before execution; use limit (1-50) and cursor for pagination. Does not run prompts.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.
